# TRIX

*Rate of change of a triple-smoothed EMA of the log price.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **TRIX** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `18` |
| Color | color | `"#F23645"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/trix.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "TRIX", shortTitle: "TRIX", overlay: false, precision: 4 });
const length = input.int("Length", 18, { min: 1 });
const lg = ta.calc([candle.close], (c) => math.log(c));
const e3 = ta.ema(ta.ema(ta.ema(lg, length), length), length);
plot(ta.calc([ta.change(e3, 1)], (d) => 10000 * d), { title: "TRIX", color: input.color("Color", "#F23645", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
